## OLS: Matrix Formula versus lm()

Simulates a simple regression and estimates its coefficients using both the matrix formula and lm().

```{webr}
set.seed(5280)
n <- 100
x <- rnorm(n)
e <- rnorm(n)
y <- 0.5 + 2 * x + e
X <- cbind(1, x)

# Matrix formula
bhat <- solve(crossprod(X), crossprod(X, y))
bhat

# R's regression routine
coef(lm(y ~ x))
```

## Monte Carlo Check of OLS Unbiasedness

Repeats the regression 500 times and averages the estimated intercept and slope.

```{webr}
set.seed(5280)
n <- 100
B <- 500
bhat <- replicate(B, {
  x <- rnorm(n)
  y <- 0.5 + 2 * x + rnorm(n)
  coef(lm(y ~ x))
})
rowMeans(bhat)
```

## OLS Error at Different Sample Sizes

Simulates samples of 50, 100, and 1,000 observations and reports coefficient-estimation error for each.

```{webr}
### (Not rigorously) Verify Consistency
set.seed(5280)
n0=c(50,100,1000); # Create three samples with n=50, 100, 1000.
diff=matrix(0,2,3)
for (sim in 1:3){
  n=n0[sim]
e=rnorm(n,0,1); x=rnorm(n,0,1); y=0.5+2*x+e; cons=rep(1,n)
X=cbind(cons,x); y=as.matrix(y,n,1)
diff[,sim]=solve(t(X)%*%X)%*%(t(X)%*%y)-matrix(c(0.5,2),2,1) # difference between bhat and b
}
colSums(abs(diff))
```

## Robust Standard Error

Fits a two-regressor model and reports an HC0-robust test for the coefficient on x1.

```{webr}
library(sandwich) # library to calculate heteroscedastic robust standard error
library(lmtest)
set.seed(5280)

n <- 500
x1 <- rnorm(n)
x2 <- rnorm(n)
y <- 0.5 + x1 + x2 + rnorm(n, sd = 0.5 + abs(x1))
fit <- lm(y ~ x1 + x2)

# HC1 heteroskedasticity-robust covariance matrix and coefficient table
V_HC1 <- vcovHC(fit, type = "HC1")
coeftest(fit, vcov. = V_HC1)
```


## Inference

Fits a two-regressor model and verify the size and power of t test and the coverage probability of confidence interval.

```{webr}
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)

set.seed(5280)

simu=1000
b_h0_1=1
b_h0_2=0
rej_1=0
rej_2=0
cover=0

for (j in 1:simu){
n <- 500
x1 <- rnorm(n)
x2 <- rnorm(n)
y <- 0.5 + x1 + x2 + rnorm(n, sd = 0.5 + abs(x1))
fit <- lm(y ~ x1 + x2)

# HC1 heteroskedasticity-robust covariance matrix and coefficient table
V_HC1 <- vcovHC(fit, type = "HC1")
coeftest(fit, vcov. = V_HC1)

# T test statistic
b1 <- coef(fit)["x1"]
se1 <- sqrt(V_HC1["x1", "x1"])
Tn_1=(b1-b_h0_1)/se1
Tn_2=(b1-b_h0_2)/se1

# Size
rej1[j]=(abs(Tn_1)>qnorm(0.975))

# Power
rej2[j]=(abs(Tn_2)>qnorm(0.975))

# 0.95 Confidence interval
CI_lower=b1 - qnorm(0.975) * se1
CI_upper=b1 + qnorm(0.975) * se1

cover[j]=(1<=CI_upper)*(1>=CI_lower)
}
mean(rej1)
mean(rej2)
mean(cover)
```
